user.title: Select Plex Server
user.description: Choose an existing Home Assistant Plex server for 1-click setup or enter URL & token manually.

manual.title: Connect to Plex Media Server
manual.description: If you picked an existing HA Plex server, URL & Token are already filled automatically — just click Submit.

data_description.url: Local Plex Media Server address, e.g. https://192.168.1.100:32400 (auto-filled from HA Plex).
data_description.token: Auto-filled from built-in Plex integration. For manual entry: Plex Web → item (⋯) → Get Info → View XML → X-Plex-Token at the end of the URL.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave OFF for local LAN IPs or self-signed Plex certificates; turn ON only if using a valid public HTTPS domain.
data_description.scan_button: The button.*_scan_clients entity from built-in Plex integration so SmartPlex discovers waking TV clients faster.
data_description.ai_entity: Used ONLY by the plex_smart.command service for text automations. Voice Assist agents (Gemini, Yandex, GigaChat, Ollama) work directly via SmartPlex LLM API without AI Task.
data_description.cache_interval: How often to refresh the local movie/show/music index in memory (default: 60 min).
data_description.user_title: Leave EMPTY for neutral replies in your Home Assistant language, or enter how SmartPlex should address you (e.g. 'Sir', 'Boss', or your name).

data_description.url: Local Plex Media Server URL (e.g. https://192.168.1.100:32400).
data_description.token: X-Plex-Token (leave unchanged unless your token expired).
data_description.verify_ssl: Keep OFF for local IP / self-signed SSL.
data_description.scan_button: Built-in Plex scan_clients button for discovering waking TVs.
data_description.ai_entity: Used only by plex_smart.command (not needed when using Assist LLM API).
data_description.cache_interval: Background library cache refresh interval in minutes.
data_description.user_title: Leave empty for neutral localized replies, or enter a custom address (e.g. 'Sir').

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SmartPlex
reauth_confirm.description: Your Plex token expired or was revoked. Enter a new X-Plex-Token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Plex server. Check URL and SSL setting.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to Plex.

abort.already_configured: This Plex server is already configured in SmartPlex.

set_zone.title: Media Zone Setup
set_zone.description: Fill in the 5 basic fields below. Advanced options (aliases, paired TV/AVR for boxes, manual entities) are collapsed and only needed for special setups.

data_description.zone_name: Human name for this player (e.g. 'Living Room LG' or 'Bedroom').
data_description.area_id: Link to an HA Area so a voice satellite in that room knows which screen to use automatically.
data_description.is_default: Turn ON if you have multiple players in the same room (e.g. LG TV + Apple TV) and want this one used whenever you don't specify a player name.
data_description.plex_client: Select the Plex app client entity (media_player.plex_*), NOT the TV itself.
data_description.power_profile: Select the device type so SmartPlex uses the right wake/app launch commands and timing presets.
data_description.hardware_device_id: Select the physical TV or streaming box device in HA. Its media_player & remote entities are detected automatically.

advanced_options.name: Advanced options (aliases, paired TV/AVR, manual overrides)
advanced_options.description: Leave collapsed for a standard Smart TV. Open only if you use an external streaming box or want custom voice aliases.

data.display_device_id: Paired TV / Projector / AVR device (for set-top boxes)
data.display_source: Paired TV / AVR HDMI input source
data.turn_off_on_handoff: Turn off this TV when transferring playback to another room

data_description.aliases: Spoken synonyms separated by commas (e.g. 'apple tv, box' or 'kids room'). Only needed if you use nicknames.
data_description.display_device_id: Fill ONLY if the player above is an external box (Apple TV / Shield) and the TV/projector/AVR does not wake via HDMI-CEC.
data_description.display_source: HDMI input name to select on the paired TV/AVR (e.g. 'Apple TV' or 'HDMI 1'). Leave empty if HDMI-CEC switches automatically.
data_description.app_source: Keep 'Plex' for almost all TVs. Change only for custom Android TV deep-links or renamed sources.
data_description.turn_off_on_handoff: Automatically powers off this TV when you ask to continue watching in another room.
data_description.hardware_entity: Leave EMPTY (auto-resolved from the Physical TV device above). Only needed for custom entities without a device.
data_description.remote_entity: Leave EMPTY (auto-resolved from the Physical TV device above). Only needed for standalone IR blasters.

zone_timings.title: Zone Timings & Start Phases
zone_timings.description: Defaults are already tuned for your selected TV profile. Adjust only if your TV boots slower or faster than usual.

data.cold_boot_timeout: Cold start: max wait for TV power-on (sec)
data.cold_os_delay: Cold start: TV OS settle delay after power-on (sec)
data.cold_app_delay: Cold start: delay after launching Plex app (sec)
data.warm_app_delay: Warm start: delay after launching Plex on awake TV (sec)
data.hot_delay: Hot start: delay when Plex is already open (sec)
data.optimistic_mode: Optimistic instant response (finish TV boot in background)
data.atv_auto_select: Apple TV: auto-press Select on Plex card to start playback

data_description.cold_boot_timeout: Used when TV is OFF. Continues early as soon as TV reports 'on', or proceeds optimistically after this limit.
data_description.cold_os_delay: Short pause after TV switches to 'on' so webOS/Tizen/tvOS accepts app commands (increase by 1–2s if Plex doesn't open on cold start).
data_description.cold_app_delay: Initial pause after opening Plex on a freshly booted TV before scanning for the client.
data_description.warm_app_delay: Pause after opening Plex when the TV was ALREADY on (also used as card-render wait on Apple TV).
data_description.hot_delay: Pause when Plex is ALREADY open and ready. Keep at 0 for instant switching.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to press Plex Scan Clients while waiting for the app to appear online.
data_description.scan_timeout: Maximum total seconds to wait for the Plex client to appear online.
data_description.play_retry_count: How many times to retry play_media if the Plex app is still initializing (e.g. brief 404).
data_description.handoff_rewind_sec: Seconds to rewind when transferring a movie to another room so you don't miss dialogue.
data_description.optimistic_mode: Recommended ON: voice assistant replies immediately while the TV wakes and starts playback in the background.
data_description.atv_auto_select: Required for Plex for Apple TV 2026.20+: automatically presses Select on the opened movie card to start playback.
data_description.custom_boot_actions: Custom HA actions to power on your hardware (IR blaster, smart plug, etc.).
data_description.custom_launch_actions: Custom HA actions to launch the Plex app.
data_description.custom_off_actions: Custom HA actions to power off your hardware on handoff.

error.not_a_plex_client: The selected entity is not a Plex client (media_player.plex_*). Choose your Plex app client here and pick your TV in the Physical TV device field.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Parent SmartPlex server is not loaded.

set_roulette.title: Movie Roulette Preset
set_roulette.description: Configure filters, collage layout, and anti-repeat window for evening movie suggestions in VK or Telegram.

data.max_duration_min: Max duration in minutes (0 = no limit)
data.anti_repeat_days: Do not repeat suggested movies for (days)

data_description.roulette_name: Name used in automations (e.g. 'Evening Movie' or 'Kids Cartoon').
data_description.libraries: Pick specific movie sections (leave empty to include all movie libraries).
data_description.watch_filter: Choose whether to suggest unwatched movies, rewatch favorites, or any.
data_description.include_genres: Leave empty for all genres, or pick specific ones (e.g. Comedy, Adventure).
data_description.exclude_genres: Blacklist genres you don't want suggested (e.g. Horror, Documentary).
data_description.min_rating: Minimum Plex/TMDB rating (0 disables the rating filter).
data_description.year_from: Skip older movies released before this year.
data_description.max_duration_min: Great for weeknights (e.g. 110 min). Set 0 for unlimited length.
data_description.pick_count: How many posters to include in the showcase (4 in a 2x2 grid looks best on phones).
data_description.anti_repeat_days: Remember suggested movies so 'Reroll' always shows fresh options.
data_description.default_zone: Target zone embedded into the inline Play buttons.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Parent SmartPlex server is not loaded.

options.samsung_tizen: Samsung Tizen TV (WoL + Plex App ID launch)
options.android_tv: Android TV / Google TV / Shield (deep-link or source)
options.custom_actions: Custom Actions (ActionSelector: IR, AVR, plugs, etc.)

command.name: AI voice/text command
command.description: Parse a natural-language command via AI Task and start playback or handoff on the target Plex zone.

zone.name: Target zone override
zone.description: Optional zone name overriding what was parsed from the command.

ai_entity.name: AI Task entity override
ai_entity.description: Optional ai_task.* entity to use instead of the default one.

play.name: Play media on zone
play.description: Directly play a movie, show, episode, music, playlist, or Plex rating_key without AI.

zone.name: Target zone
zone.description: Zone name, alias, or HA Area.

track.name: Track / Song
track.description: Music song or track title (works with or without artist).

similar_to.name: Similar to
similar_to.description: Play an unwatched movie or show similar to this title.

actors.name: Actors (together / AND)
actors.description: List of actors who must all appear together in the same movie or show.

actors_original.name: Actors (English names)
actors_original.description: Optional English actor names in the same order for bilingual matching.

candidate_titles.name: Candidate titles
candidate_titles.description: Optional list of known collaboration or plot-matched titles to cross-check in the library.

genre.name: Genre
genre.description: Genre filter matched against server tags.

library.name: Library name
library.description: Restrict search to a specific Plex section.

sort_order.name: Sort order
sort_order.description: default, newest, oldest, top_rated, or random.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Continue from saved position / next unwatched episode.

handoff.name: Transfer playback / Continue watching
handoff.description: Transfer active Plex playback from another room (optionally turning off the previous TV) or resume Continue Watching.

source_zone.name: Source zone
source_zone.description: Explicit source room; auto-detected if omitted.

turn_off_source.name: Turn off previous TV
turn_off_source.description: Override whether to power off the previous zone's TV.

media_type.name: Media type filter
media_type.description: Optional filter ('movie', 'show', or 'music') when continuing from On Deck.

control.name: Control playback & seek
control.description: Pause, unpause, stop, restart, seek forward/backward by seconds, jump to timestamp, skip tracks, or toggle repeat/shuffle on an active Plex zone.

action.name: Action
action.description: pause, resume_play, play_pause, stop, seek_relative, seek_to, restart, next, previous, set_repeat, or set_shuffle.

zone.name: Target zone
zone.description: Optional zone name; defaults to the currently active Plex room.

offset_sec.name: Target position (sec)
offset_sec.description: Exact position in seconds for action='seek_to' (e.g. 1800 for 30:00).

delta_sec.name: Relative shift (sec)
delta_sec.description: Signed seconds shift for action='seek_relative' (e.g. 10 or -10).

repeat.name: Repeat mode
repeat.description: off, one, or all for action='set_repeat'.

spin_roulette.name: Spin Movie Roulette
spin_roulette.description: Pick filtered movies, render a numbered poster collage, and return VK & Telegram inline keyboards.

preset.name: Roulette preset
preset.description: Name or ID of a configured Roulette Preset subentry.

zone.name: Target zone
zone.description: Zone embedded into callback play buttons.

libraries.name: Libraries override
libraries.description: List of Plex movie library names.

max_duration_min.name: Max duration (min)
max_duration_min.description: Maximum movie length in minutes (0 = unlimited).

anti_repeat_days.name: Anti-repeat window (days)
anti_repeat_days.description: Do not suggest the same movie within N days.

refresh_cache.name: Refresh library cache
refresh_cache.description: Immediately re-index all Plex libraries, genres, and playlists.
